name: Stop the run ending at the first screenful: confirm the applicant list has really settled, and grow it without depending on having identified its scroller
request: Stop the run ending at the first screenful: confirm the applicant list has really settled, and grow it without depending on having identified its scroller
checks: npm run check passed (typecheck, build, 411 tests, validate)
result: The run no longer ends at the first screenful. Two independent causes, both in the on-demand list growth that every run actually uses. (1) ONE observation was the whole verdict: a single pass that ended at the bottom having revealed nothing went straight to the pager, and with no pager in sight broke out - after which extractAllApplicants saw no further row and marked the run COMPLETED. A slice still in flight over the network, or a scroll target with no range, therefore finished a 665-applicant job somewhere in the first dozen rows and reported it done. The bottom now has to be confirmed by LIST_QUIET_PASSES consecutive quiet passes before the pager is consulted, which is the rule the full walk has had since 3.7.8; a fruitless pager click resets that counter so the next press earns the same confirmation, and fruitless still retires the control after three. LIST_GROW_PASSES rose 6 to 16 to cover confirm-plus-click for each allowed attempt. (2) The container being driven is a GUESS, and when it is wrong maxScrollPosition answers 0, every pass reads as already-at-the-bottom and no row can ever arrive - silent, exactly like the panel defect. nudgeListToLastRow() drags the last rendered row into view with scrollIntoView, which scrolls whatever scrollable ancestor it needs and so needs no guess; it is a read and presses nothing. Both walks use it, and the list is now re-resolved per pass because a detached container keeps answering with the range it had when it was unmounted. No control and no click was added: the budget is still seven.
